title: Equivalent dose RAdiography and CONe Beam ct for carpal fractures
summary: In this study, we will compare dose-equivalent radiographic and computed tomography scans regarding their diagnostic value for carpal fractures.

interventions.name: For the included patients, a CT scan with the equivalent X-ray dose and an MRI of the hand are performed on the same day.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Complete orientation
- Adult patients
- X-ray diagnosis of the hand already done, with clinical issues remained open
- Clinical indication for a CT examination of the hand
Exclusion criteria:
- Not able to consent
- underage
- Pregnant
- Contraindications for MRI:
o Pacemakers, insulin pumps, neurostimulators, pain pumps or cochlear implants
o Great tattoos or piercings
o claustrophobia
